verdict.rationale: A community report says GitLab's built-in GitHub importer brings over the repository along with issues, pull requests, review comments, wiki pages, milestones, labels, release notes and cross-references. That covers every element of the story. However, this rests on a single community source with no first-party documentation in the pack, and partner migration services (Relokia, Unito) do not count as the product's own capability. Missing for 10: first-party import documentation, evidence of importers for hosting platforms other than GitHub, and hands-on corroboration of review/comment fidelity.
